_why: RESCOPED 2026-09-06 after the filer's own correction (first comment on #2000). The issue body is OVERSTATED: both null-pad batch merges consult a plan-time `output_layout` FIRST (coordinator/mod.rs:3962, :3992) and only fall back to `seen_*_fields`. That fallback is deliberate and documented, not an overlooked sampling bug. MEASURED reachability (the thing the correction said was missing): `output_layout` is set only by `with_output_schema`, and is None in exactly two shapes — (1) SELF-JOIN, where it returns early at :503 to preserve the byte-identity invariant, and (2) `cache_inputs` absent at engine/interval_join.rs:270. So the sampled fallback IS reachable, and a self-join is the cheapest shape that reaches it. Because self-joins REQUIRE the fallback, failing loudly there is wrong; the fix is to widen the remembered set rather than freeze row 0's. Part B (field_names_for_source's fabricated [id,name,value,amount,timestamp]) is uncontested and independent of the layout path — the correction calls it 'arguably worse'. Attempt 1 (glm) was briefed WITHOUT the layout-first branch and stalled 38 minutes trying to construct a failing test for a path it was never told how to reach; it produced nothing and was killed.

returns five FABRICATED column names when a relation has no schema and no sample row. Delete the guess, fail loud.

blast_radius._note: Both production changes are confined to two files: coordinator/mod.rs (seen_*_fields is 10 refs, all in that one file) and processors/join.rs. Tests add a third. Tripwire in the brief at >4 files.

grammar_reference._note: §3 defines the four physical join layouts; §1b defines what a qualified miss does. The defect is only legible against §1b: absence yields Null OR a hard error depending on bare-name collision across the two sides.

tests._note: fail_to_pass names are INDICATIVE — what is required is a heterogeneous side (rows beyond the first carrying extra columns) across LEFT and FULL OUTER expiry, in BOTH the bare-name-collision and no-collision variants; they fail differently (hard error vs silent Null) and one passing does not imply the other. Each MUST be verified to FAIL against unmodified master BEFORE the production change. If none can be made to fail, that is a SUCCESSFUL run: report the negative result and stop. pass_to_stay is the existing homogeneous-shape nullfill regression in tests/unit/sql/execution/processors/join/left_join_nullfill_row_identity_test.rs — do not modify it.
